subject: Council Composition and Ward Representation
overview: The Charter Study Committee subcommittee met to define its scope and assign research tasks regarding city council composition and hybrid ward representation. Members reviewed historical ward-by-ward voter turnout data and delegated individual research topics to prepare draft language for the full committee.

items.title: Subcommittee Scope and Objectives
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed narrowing its scope to researching hybrid ward representation versus expanding at-large council seats in order to draft proposed charter sections for the full committee.

items.title: Municipal Models and Legal Framework
items.summary: Members discussed exploring state general laws, consulting the Collins Center, comparing Malden's hybrid council model, and examining the legal precedent set by the Lowell court case on ward representation.

items.title: Review of Ward Voting Data
items.summary: Eunice Browne presented a detailed data sheet outlining registered voters, turnout percentages, and vote counts by ward and precinct from the 2021 municipal election.

items.title: Task Assignments and Future Meetings
items.summary: Members agreed on individual research assignments covering census demographics, state laws, legal precedent, historical election trends, and candidate outreach before tentatively scheduling their next meeting for August 24.
